## App submission

- [ ] This PR adds or updates exactly one app under `apps/<package-id>/`.
- [ ] The manifest ID matches the directory and the version was incremented.
- [ ] Source and build instructions are complete; no prebuilt opaque library is used.
- [ ] License and third-party notices are included.
- [ ] No ROM, BIOS, WAD, game, copyrighted media, credential, or personal data is included.
- [ ] The app uses only the public IdreesWatch module ABI.
- [ ] I tested start, input, exit, relaunch, and clean uninstall behavior.

Merging makes an app discoverable in the curated catalog. It never causes a
watch to download or update the app automatically.
